triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '11. Treating M=1 Event Average As The Only Parity Signal' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 11. Treating M=1 Event Average As The Only Parity Signal

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL FP8 PTPC Fused MoE on MI308X -- 11. Treating M=1 Event Average As The Only Parity Signal

payload.attempted: Fail or accept M=1 based only on a single e2e event average.
payload.lesson: Diagnose M=1 with trace guard first, then stage1/stage2 sums and e2e min, then e2e average. Rerun event timing only after the trace is clean.

established_fact.mechanism: M=1 has tiny stage kernels and visible event-average jitter. In task11, one full run saw `622.0us` M=1 e2e average while the kernel trace and kernel sum were aligned; the immediate M=1 rerun was `526.2us`, and the final full run passed at `530.4us`.

payload.observed: A clean kernel trace can be misclassified as a regression, or a real trace regression can be missed if one event average happens to pass.
payload.root_cause: M=1 has tiny stage kernels and visible event-average jitter. In task11, one full run saw `622.0us` M=1 e2e average while the kernel trace and kernel sum were aligned; the immediate M=1 rerun was `526.2us`, and the final full run passed at `530.4us`.
